scope: All of the existing MX riding corridor, all jumps, both roller sections and connecting corners; road circuits and physical terrain unchanged.
dirt: Predominantly longitudinal tractor grooming on all straightaways and jump faces. No diagonal scuff paths or cross-track bank comb pattern; accepted photo soil palette retained.
palette: Exact accepted photographic loose/packed colour and normal tiles, with the accepted earthy palette and matte alpha 2. Macro dirt uses subtle irregular mottling rather than line-based colour.
optimization: One historic-layer mask removal each at R03, R10 and R17. Every trial scoped separately; no global layer removal. Same 14 layers and shared atlas pair; measure actual archive change.
grass: Denser photographic blades with green material tint and alpha edge bleed, plus green verge ground coverage in the existing grass layer. Visual-only, no shadow casting, approved trees and non-grass scenery exact.
